name: podcast-interview-guide
description:
Produces a podcast interview guide with rapport-building openers, primary
topic questions with follow-up probes, lightning round questions, and a
closing sequence. Includes active listening cues and redirect language.
Use when the user asks to prepare interview questions for a podcast guest,
plan a podcast interview, or create a question flow for a conversation.
Do NOT use for full episode planning with segments and timing (use
podcast-episode-planning), audio production settings (use audio-editing-guide),
or non-podcast interview preparation (use interview-prep).
